roads.name: Edward N. Hines Drive
words: Sweeping and steady: 34 curves in 13.8 miles.
From 590 to 720 ft, with 700 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
Built up in places.
34 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 84°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 40 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.16 g.
